description: CUR-LIFE (F: clone created before BeginTrans), variant: Update, close the clone, Rollback (repeat of the one case of the first card). A dynaset on T at ID 1 makes a Clone BEFORE the transaction; BeginTrans; Edit N of ID 1 to 9001; Update; the clone is closed (Errors read); EditMode of the parent is read; the remaining transaction calls are issued and their Errors read; row ID 1 is then read from a new snapshot.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
